Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
3.1.4. Withdrawing from an Event

Players choosing to withdraw from an event must inform the scorekeeper
before the seatings for the next round are generated. Players leaving the
tournament after the scorekeeper begins seatings for the next round receive
a "Loss" in the upcoming round and will be removed from the event after that
round.

Does this mean that if someone withdraw before the final, that person is not
replaced and thus only 4 people play in the final? Or will his/her seat be
taken by the perosn who ended up 6th in total the previous rounds?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Since the seating for the final cannot be determined without the participation
of the five players in the final, the question is moot.

If one of the finalists drops out before the final, then the 6th place player
would be in the finals (and so on until five players are available - or 4 if
only 4 players are left).
